Attached is an initial draft of the integration validation matrix (migration-validation-matrix.xlsx). High level notes:

- Matrix structure: integration area / test case / input data / expected behavior / pass criteria / test owner / automation level / estimated effort.
- Key integration areas covered: REST API endpoints (generation, chat, embeddings), Ingress (VPC peering + NLB), Secrets/KMS access patterns, Audit log export to Splunk, Persistent KV cache correctness for long-running sessions, Token billing reconciliation.
- Canary plan (summary row in sheet):
  * Canary window: 7 days in us-west-2 with 5% traffic split routed via canary gateway.
  * Success criteria: sustained error rate <0.5% and median 95th pct latency within 10% of baseline for 24 hours.
  * Rollback triggers: sustained error-rate >0.5% for 30 minutes OR token accounting divergence >0.2% over 1 hour.
- Test automation: most infra checks can be run via our e2e infra suite (scripts referenced in sheet). Manual functional checks for chat/stateful sessions called out.

I've added column G with suggested test owners (redwood-devops, cygnus-arch, cygnus-sre). Need Marissa to convert the canary plan into a customer-friendly runbook doc that lists communications, run windows, stakeholders, and gating checklist.

Attachment: migration-validation-matrix.xlsx (Excel stub)

- Rishi
